scope: C_WITCH ERNA standard idle1, execute1, walk6 only; BODY01 hem tab and BODY02 lining trim center proposals. Not a complete 54-frame overlay.
method: Root visually confirmed coat-edge boundary points directly on original 256x256 RGBA sources: idle1 [201,204], execute1 [216,205], walk6 [190,207]. Fresh R002 source grid is rendered from originals only. Alpha is used only as edge-support and to measure actual candidate alpha protrusion after compositing behind body; it does not determine garment semantics. Renderer center placement and 0.12*256=30.72px rendered detail size are used.
rendererContract: EquipmentDetailRenderer positions SKSpriteNode by its center at normalized point; `placement_px_top_left` is a misleading legacy key. Preview composites place the candidate texture behind original body, with size 0.12 * 256 = 30.72px.
